Len_2H_01: ^As you walk towards the lake, you notice Lena in her usual spot, laying down with eyes closed.
^Is that you, Ari? Thought my shift started later tonight...
^No wait, it's not Ari. Ari would've been mid-lecture by now.
^Lena peeks over at you, making the least amount of effort possible in seeing who disturbed her.
^What brings you over to the forest? Seems like quite the walk from your farm.

c-0: ^Just thought that I'd do some fishing while I've got the time.
^Ugh... you and just about everyone else.
^I swear, you'd think that this is the only spot in the settlement to fish anymore.
^Well actually Lena, it kind of is the only spot if you're fishing for lakewater fish such as some bass or sturgeon.
^Alright fine, you can fish here. Just don't disturb me too much while I'm meditating, yeah?
^If you do, I'll make sure to throw you in the lake with your precious sturgeon.
c-1: ^Just out here to grab some herbs. Maybe some flowers.
^You can really make some awesome food with the herbs around here.
^Just make sure you don't pick anything toxic. Lots of toxic berries around here.
^And if you're looking for flowers, you might not find too many around.
^Yours truly already picked some, plus Arno and sometimes even Bryan grabs some too.
^Yup, that's the guy. Doesn't seem like the flower type, does he?
^Lotta people in this town still have their layers, even if we're a lot less people than back on Earth.
^I'm sure eventually you'll see. Just give people time to open up to you.
c-2: ^Well the farm is running low on lumber, so I thought I'd grab some from here since there's plenty of trees to go around.
^Umm, no. If you're gonna make a bunch of noise, go and do it somewhere else.
^And actually, why do you need wood in the first place? You're a farmer, not a carpenter. Stop cutting down trees just because.
^I just craft some things locally on the farm. Lot easier that way.
^Well I don't care. Last thing this forest needs is another person taking what they want from it...
^Sorry, *player*. I didn't mean to lash out at you.
^But I've read about how you guys treated Earth in the past.
^I just don't want that to happen here on Raea too.
g-0: ^Whatever you're gonna do, just make sure you're not gonna bother me.
^Or if you want, you can join me and meditate a bit.
^It's a good way to take a break from the hustle and bustle of daily life, y'know?
^Actually, I think I'll take you up on that.
^Really? Huh... was not expecting you to actually accept.
^And if you don't mind, I tend to be silent when I'm meditating.
^You take a seat next to Lena, and spend quite a bit of time just taking in the sights and sounds.
^As you reflect on your time on Raea, you realize that you haven't really had a chance to take in all that has happened.
^How you haven't had time to process, much less grieve, your fellow crewmates that you never got to see again.
^As you process your thoughts and emotions, you aren't sure how much time has passed...

Len_2H_02: ^Well, I should probably get back to my place, need to run a couple errands before my shift at the inn tonight.
^But if you're ever feeling a little stressed out, you should meditate here by the lake.
^It's a great way to just disconnect from the settlement and think through any problems you might be having.
^I'm here most days, so don't be afraid to join me if I'm already all set up.
^But thanks for joining me here today...
